description: The same 15-minute crypto "up or down" window priced on polymarket.com, Polymarket US and Kalshi, side by side, with whether each pair is actually the same contract. Pass asset (btc | eth | sol | xrp | bnb) and window ("current" default, "next", "previous", or the window START as ISO such as 2026-10-27T14:15:00Z, on a 15-minute boundary). Per venue: question, Up bid / ask / mid / last, spread_pp, quote_state, volume WITH ITS UNIT, open interest, liquidity, settlement source, comparison basis, wh

asset.description: btc (default) | eth | sol | xrp | bnb. Coverage differs by venue; a venue that does not list the asset answers not_listed.

window.description: "current" (default), "next", "previous", or the window START as an ISO-8601 timestamp on a 15-minute boundary, e.g. 2026-10-27T14:15:00Z. An unaligned timestamp is refused, not rounded.

name: newton__updown_venue_compare
